page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s3.large is an x86_64 architecture virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 4 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 4 physical cores with a single thread per core configuration, meaning hyperthreading is not active. The instance is provisioned with 8.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 2.0 GB per core. There is no local NVMe or SSD storage bundled with this instance, requiring external block storage volumes for operating system and application data. No GPU accelerators are present on this hardware profile.

With a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the ecs.s3.large is structured for compute-focused workloads that do not demand large memory footprints. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing performance without resource contention from other tenants on the host. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the lack of integrated local storage and GPU hardware positions this instance as a utility-oriented resource for workloads requiring predictable CPU execution. It is suitable for lightweight web serving, distributed compute nodes, microservices, and basic batch processing tasks that fit within the 8.0 GB memory boundary.
